name: Spring Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232829 (99 days observed, edges closes)
note: 35 sites (about 12 reservable, remainder first-come, first-served) at ~5,700 ft near Frenchman Lake in Plumas NF; paved roads and parking pads, bear lockers; site 23 accessible; reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Lakeshore East Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232758 (312 days observed, edges closes)
note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Sacramento Arm of Shasta Lake near Lakehead; 24 standard sites (plus 2 yurts) with paved parking spurs, no hookups or dump station; back-in sites to ~30 ft, with several offering direct lake access. Reservable on recreation.gov (walk-ins year-round). --Claude

name: Cal-Ida Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234538 (113 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tahoe NF (Yuba River RD) on Hwy 49 in forest across the road from the North Yuba River, ~13 mi from Downieville. Single-family sites (mix of tent-only and RV nonelectric); largest RV site fits 30 ft (site 003). Vault toilets, no hookups, reservable. ~2,330 ft. --Claude

name: Indian Valley Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234548 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tahoe NF (Yuba River RD) on Hwy 49 along the North Yuba River. Single- and double-family standard nonelectric sites, RVs/trailers with max vehicle to 40 ft (sites 002/007), vault toilets, no hookups, reservable. ~2,300 ft. --Claude

name: Loganville Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234541 (105 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tahoe NF (Yuba River RD) on Hwy 49 along the North Yuba River near Sierra City. Single-family drive-in back-in sites (tent-designated, no hookups); several fit vehicles to 23-28 ft (site 01 = 28 ft; sites 02/05/06/08 = 23-25 ft), vault toilets, reservable. ~4,060 ft. --Claude

name: Ice House Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232061 (112 days observed, edges closes)
note: Eldorado NF campground in the Crystal Basin above Ice House Reservoir (~5,400 ft) on paved Ice House Rd. ~81 sites across several loops including RV nonelectric sites (Boat Ramp and Boulder loops); no hookups. Mix of reservable and first-come sites. --Claude

name: Grasshopper Flat Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232830 (120 days observed, edges closes)
note: Plumas NF campground on the east shore of Lake Davis (Beckwourth RD), 70+ single-family standard non-electric sites, vault toilets, no hookups, boat ramp nearby; drive-in sites take RVs to ~50 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Frenchman Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232137 (100 days observed, edges closes)
note: Plumas NF campground at Frenchman Lake (Beckwourth RD), ~38 drive-in standard non-electric sites, vault toilets, no hookups; sites take RVs to ~45 ft. Reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Logger Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232858 (112 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS Tahoe National Forest campground on Stampede Reservoir near Truckee (RV Life mis-tags it commercial; it is federal). 240+ sites in six loops (Cross Cut, Iron Ox, Steam Donkey, Whistle Punk, Ox Bow, Double Bit), vault toilets and drinking water, no hookups; single, double and triple-family sites fit RVs; boat ramp under a mile away. Listed on recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Lower Onion Creek Campground (Colorado River, Moab)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 255118 (297 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: BLM campground on the Colorado River off SR-128, 22 miles up the river road from US-191 north of Moab, across from the Fisher Towers turnoff; a river-trip put-in with two boat ramps. 21 first-come, first-served sites (cash or check) plus two reservable group sites; toilets, no hookups. No published length, but reviewers report rigs up to 40 ft and trailers. Minimal cell service. The river has dangerous undercurrents. --Claude
